description.en: Loads and runs the fixed master-avatar event script (data/script/event/ev42132000.nutb), passing it the given event ID and NPC handle, then drives its Event coroutine to completion frame by frame. Used for NPCs of the "master avatar" event type — likely the community-master NPCs that sell player cards / Fighting Spirit-related content ("avatar" is the engine's internal word for a Fighting Spirit, see CMND_ATTACH_AVATAR), though the exact role of this specific event type was not traced further.
Event ID passed through to the loaded script as subev_ctx.id.
NPC handle passed through to the loaded script as subev_ctx.npc_hdl.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

examples.case: Dispatching to the right event runner depending on the NPC's event type (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_std.nut)
